name: Family at Home 2
source:
Family at Home 2 is inspired by parts of the story of the Dynasty series, you are a young man living happily with your father and mother, but after the revelation of a man named Blake, your life changes completely. You begin to live a life with one of the wealthiest families in town, the Pritzkers. You have a luxurious and glamorous life, but it will eventually be filled with darkness, forged from dark money, betrayal, jealousy, sex, and even murder. All this conflict is seen from your perspective.

[From Itch.io]
translation:
《家家有道2》的灵感来自《王朝》系列的部分故事，你是一个与父母幸福生活的年轻人，但在一个名叫布莱克的男人的揭露后，你的生活彻底改变了。你开始与镇上最富有的家庭之一普利兹克家族一起生活。你拥有奢华光鲜的生活，但它最终会充满黑暗，由黑钱、背叛、嫉妒、性，甚至谋杀所锻造。所有这些冲突都是从你的角度来看的。

[来自Itch.io]
